'''Docking Bay D-768''' was a [[Hangar/Legends|docking bay]] situated within [[Fleet Support]]'s [[Fleet Support Air Station|Air Station]]<ref name="RC:HC" /> on the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]. In use by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army]]<ref name="RC:HC" /> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' places the events of ''[[Republic Commando: Hard Contact]]'', which includes the appearance of Docking Bay D-768, in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> Docking Bay D-768 housed a [[Nar Shaddaa agri-utility crop sprayer]] that transported the [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commandos]] of [[Omega Squad]] to the nearby world of [[Qiilura/Legends|Qiilura]] on a [[Mission to Qiilura|mission]] to locate and neutralize [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Ovolot Qail Uthan]] in order to suspend her progress on the [[Cloning/Legends|clone]]-[[Death/Legends|killing]] [[nanovirus]]<ref name="RC:HC" /> [[FG36]].<ref name="IC:501">''[[Imperial Commando: 501st]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Docking Bay D-768 appeared in the [[2004]] novel [[Republic Commando: Hard Contact|''Hard Contact'']], the first novel in the ''[[Republic Commando]]'' series written by [[Karen Traviss]].<ref name="RC:HC" />
